method: Actual signed ATOM desktop composer and runtime logs, sequential GPT-6 Luna / Low turns. Baseline and first candidate each have one fresh chat after an app restart; final candidate has three fresh chats, including one after restart and two while the app is running. No independent UI paint measurement.

timing_definitions.setup: Adapter entry through verified session readiness. Stages use performance.now().
timing_definitions.first_text: Core dispatch through first nonempty model text delivered to the stream. Nonstreaming fallback is marked at Core completion. This is not native window paint time.
timing_definitions.completion: Existing Core modelMs, including local Core work, not speech playback.
timing_definitions.caveat: Single pre-change instrumented sample and small post-change sample. Remote/network and process warming vary; no p95 or universal speedup claim.

changes: Replace pre-thread MCP connection inventory with effective config/read, disable inherited entries by name, retain final active-thread verification.
Disable discovered standalone Codex skills through thread-only overrides. Keep ATOM tools, skills, base instructions and history/permissions intact.
Record stage timings, first text, restart reasons, sizes and raw per-request/cumulative usage. Full tool definition changes now trigger replay rather than silently retaining stale schemas.

context_breakdown.explanation: Sizes measure raw ATOM payload components, not model-token counts; tool-spec bytes exclude provider framing. Skill metadata is discovery JSON, not the exact rendered catalog. The approximately 5.1K-token ablation difference is attributable mainly to the inherited catalog; changing time/context may contribute a few tokens. Remaining 11.6K provider tokens include provider framing/context and are not fully attributable locally.

cache_findings.original_miss_root_cause: Not established: the earlier benchmark did not retain raw per-request counts or session restart metadata.
cache_findings.boundary: A reused session does not guarantee a provider cache hit. No evidence in this run of an accounting subtraction error or unexpected session reset on the four final follow-ups.

verification.command: pnpm typecheck; node --test services/llm-gateway/src/providers/codex-session.test.ts apps/mac/src/codex-tools.test.ts apps/mac/src/native-core.test.ts apps/mac/src/voice-loop.test.ts
verification.scope: Protocol/bootstrap refusal, no global config writes, native permission refusals, real temporary-file host edits with explicit grant reuse and cross-chat refusal, cancellation, full history/prefix replay, first-text timing and cache accounting. Fake provider protocol and actual host filesystem/store checks; no new live file-edit grant was created.
verification.live_quality: Two word-position answers were wrong (benchmark ready instead of Cedar benchmark). Both failures are retained. Direct quotation checks in all three final chats and saved notebook facts after reopening passed; saved pre-change messages compare byte-for-byte. This is not a generalized model quality proof.
